verdict.rationale: OpenHands' CLI documents an 'auto-approve all actions (use with caution)' setting, implying a default mode where actions require manual approval, which supports a general action-review gate, but no evidence specifically describes reviewing a code diff before it is turned into a pull request. Missing for 10: explicit diff-review UI/step, confirmation flow tied specifically to PR creation, and hands-on confirmation that this works as described.
